caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object resembling a handled tankard or lidded stein with a broad, flared base. The main body of the vessel is cylindrical and gray in color, rendered with a shading technique that gives it a metallic appearance. The vessel has a lid connected to a short golden vertical rod, which is attached to the vessel by a small, gold-colored chain. The handle is an open loop, attached to the vessel at the side. The base is wide and domed, supporting the cylindrical section above. In the bottom left corner of the composition, there is a smaller, monochrome technical sketch of the same object, showing approximate dimensions (height 6 3/4 inches, base diameter 3 3/8 inches). The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color, and there is a signature "A. Seidenberg" at the bottom right corner.
title: Petticoat Lamp
